Usage: litradar <COMMAND> [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  serve      Run HTTP and scheduling as one service
  admin      Manage administrators, secrets, and backups
  index      Build or update searchable article indexes
  cfp        Import or refresh original journal calls for papers
  notify     Deliver recommendation notifications
  push       Push tracking updates
  scheduler  Validate or run scheduled tasks manually
  openapi    Emit the generated OpenAPI document

result.instructions: Use LitRadar tools to query indexed papers and favorites.

tools.name: add_favorite
tools.description: Add an article to a favorite folder for the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a single article by ID.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Get a single journal by ID.

tools.name: get_weekly_updates
tools.description: Get weekly update summaries across all LitRadar databases.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List research areas for the selected LitRadar database.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List favorite folders for the authenticated LitRadar user.

tools.name: list_journal_options
tools.description: List journal filter options for the selected LitRadar database.

tools.name: list_journal_ratings
tools.description: List exact UTD, ABS, FMS and FMS China grades with journal counts for the selected database. Empty groups mean no rating information.

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: List journals from the selected LitRadar database.

abs_rating.description: Exact ABS grades; 4* is a literal grade, not a wildcard.

utd_rating.description: Exact UTD grades; OR within a system, AND across systems and other filters.

tools.name: list_years
tools.description: List publication years for the selected LitRadar database.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.description: Remove an article from a favorite folder for the authenticated user.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search articles in the LitRadar index.
